decisions.scope: Historical routed-error probe and universal cleanup guarantees
decisions.quote: Cleanup in 6.3.12 looks up the validator's configured name, while routed errors are stored under their returned error keys. These must match. An anonymous `validators.validation` function returning `{ match: { errorPath: 'b' } }` can leave `b.errors.match` behind after sibling `a` makes the group rule valid. A named Boolean `match` rule with `errorPath: 'b'` cleared it in the focused probe. Use matching names or explicit application-owned routing, and test editing the non-target sibling; do not assume every routed error self-clears. [K08](sources.md#k08), [evaluation evidence](evaluation-evidence.json)
decisions.rationale: Historical evaluation artifact remains unopened. No observed probe result is imported; arbitrary routed-error cleanup remains explicitly unguaranteed.
